description: Updates an existing event in Google Calendar. Only the fields provided will be updated (PATCH semantics). Can update title, description, location, time, and attendees. Returns the updated event details.

attachments.description: File attachments for the event. Maximum 25 attachments. Each attachment requires a file_url. For Google Drive files, use the Drive file URL format. Setting this replaces all existing attachments.

file_url.description: URL link to the attachment. Required.

attendees.description: New list of attendee email addresses.

calendar_id.description: Calendar ID containing the event. Defaults to "primary".

end_date.description: New end date for all-day events (e.g., "2024-01-02"). Use this for all-day events.

end_datetime.description: New end date-time in RFC3339 format (e.g., "2024-01-01T11:00:00-05:00"). Use this for timed events.

end_timezone.description: Time zone for end time (e.g., "America/New_York"). Optional.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to update.

send_updates.description: Whether to send update notifications. "all" sends to all attendees, "externalOnly" to external attendees only, "none" sends no notifications.

start_date.description: New start date for all-day events (e.g., "2024-01-01"). Use this for all-day events.

start_datetime.description: New start date-time in RFC3339 format (e.g., "2024-01-01T10:00:00-05:00"). Use this for timed events.

start_timezone.description: Time zone for start time (e.g., "America/New_York"). Optional.

name: update_calendar_event
